name: Silver Tongued
source:
You are a monster known as the “silver-tongued”
Your goal is simple: convince the most powerful cosmic terrors to steal their souls and rule the world.

But will your greatest obstacle be them underestimating you... or your haunting past?

[From [url=https://arkicade.itch.io/a-monsters-insight]Itch.io[/url]]
